messages:
Lina Park: Quick heads-up 1: we're doing a staggered global publish for the benchmark blog next Wed: APAC 08:00 SGT, EU 10:00 CET, US 10:00 PT. Need ops for staggered embargos and localized assets.
Mateo Ruiz: Copy. I'll own EU + US press lists. Sasha 1; can you own APAC outreach and translations?
Sasha Ivanov: On it. Working with localization to prep EN/JP/KO/ZH and a short Japanese press blurb. Localizations team asked for final copy by EOD Mon.
Ivy Chen: Social plan: we'll post immediately in each region at local publish time and then do a global recap 2 hours after the last window. Need localized captions.
Localizations Bot: Reminder: translation queue created for tags [benchmarks, launch]. ETA: EN -> JP/KO/ZH by 2026-11-02T18:00Z.
press-bot: Embargo windows set: APAC 08:00 SGT, EU 10:00 CET, US 10:00 PT. Auto-hold applied; manual resume required per region.
Lina Park: Legal flagged a customer sentence in the EU draft. Replace named customer with "an early adopter" across locales. Mateo, can you push the change to all localized files?
Mateo Ruiz: Will do. Also note: one analyst in UK expects an embargoed briefing 30m before EU publish. I'll schedule that at 09:30 CET.
Sasha Ivanov: APAC partners asked for a snippet in Japanese for syndication. Legal says provide only the one-paragraph summary, no raw numbers. I'll watermark "Embargoed" on partner assets.
Ivy Chen: Ops: we'll use three Slack threads to mirror region activity: #press-watch-apac, #press-watch-eu, #press-watch-us. During each window, post press pickups/screenshots in the corresponding channel.
Localizations Bot: Asset note: hero images localized (EN/JP/KO/ZH) queued. Designer expects final approval from Lina by 16:00 PT today.
Lina Park: I'll check hero images now. Also need an exec comms readiness matrix: who to call if major pickup before an embargo lifts?
Mateo Ruiz: Exec escalation: if pickup before the scheduled region embargo, notify @exec-comm and call Legal. I'll own EU escalation.
Sasha Ivanov: APAC escalation: ping @apac-leads + call Lina. I'll be monitoring press DMs from 07:30 SGT.
Ivy Chen: Social hold detail: press-bot will hold queued posts per region. I need manual resume for each region once press lists are OK and local legal gives thumbs up.
press-bot: Social queues paused by region: APAC (id pq-342), EU (pq-343), US (pq-344). Manual resume required.
Lina Park: Quick reactive templates please: short neutral quote + FAQ about methodology. Keep it identical across locales (translated versions will follow).
Mateo Ruiz: Drafted a neutral template: "Our internal benchmarks reflect representative customer workloads; full methodology will be published with the report. Contact press@ for details." Posting to PR drive: https://drive.redwood/pr/global/reactive-template-v1
Sasha Ivanov: Translating Mateo's template into JP/KO/ZH now and posting to the same folder.
Ivy Chen: Also prepping a one-paragraph customer-facing email to partners reminding them not to syndicate until their region's embargo lifts. Will share for review in 30m.
Localizations Bot: Translation upload complete for JP/KO/ZH. Files: pr/global/ja.md, pr/global/ko.md, pr/global/zh.md.
Lina Park: Final operational checklist: 1) Legal sign-off per region 2) Design hero approval 3) Social queue resume 4) Press monitoring assigned. If all green, we resume region queue 15 minutes before local publish for final last-minute holds.
Mateo Ruiz: Legal for EU confirmed exec-friendly wording and removal of customer name. EU brief scheduled 09:30 CET with analysts.
Sasha Ivanov: APAC legal review pending but on track. I9ll post sign-off here once complete.
Ivy Chen: I'll stand by to resume social queues and push the localized posts when Lina gives the green. Will also monitor #press-watch channels for screenshots.
press-bot: Reminder 15m before each region publish a notification will be posted to the corresponding #press-watch channel.
Lina Park: Thanks all. Final check-in tomorrow 09:00 PT in this thread. If we get no objections by EOD today, proceed with the staggered windows as planned. :white_check_mark:
